interpretation.question: Which countries have the most recruiting trials for non-small cell lung cancer?

meta.count_unit: registered studies (interventional and observational, any status)

search_semantics.condition: query.cond term search with synonym expansion over conditions, titles, condition MeSH terms and keywords; terms are not matched as an exact phrase.
search_semantics.statuses: filter.overallStatus: overall status equals one of the requested values.

assumptions.message: The plan was drafted from the question by the LLM (gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 via openai) and validated; meta.interpretation.draft holds the draft. Counts come from the registry.
Question asked for a ranking; showing top 15 (configurable); 50 buckets omitted
Served from the local cache stored at 2026-10-18 20:51 UTC.
Countries are reported as the API gives them; territories are not rolled up.
A trial counts once in each location country it lists, so bucket counts can add up to more than the 1297 trials.

No 'Other' bar: a trial can count in several location country values, so summing the omitted values would double-count trials; meta.top_n.trials_omitted gives the trials that appear only in omitted values.

warnings.message: Showing the top 15 location country values by trial count; 50 location country values omitted; 79 trials appear only in omitted values and are not shown.
